university.name: Angeles University Foundation
university.tagline: Forming truly excellent professionals, imbued with a Catholic identity.
university.description: Angeles University Foundation (AUF) is a premier Catholic university in Central Luzon committed to academic excellence, Catholic values, and community service.
university.address: MacArthur Highway, Angeles City, Pampanga, Philippines 2009
university.vision: AUF envisions itself as a leading Catholic university in Asia committed to excellence through instruction, research, and community service.
university.mission: AUF commits itself to form truly excellent and ethical graduates who are committed to truth, justice, and the common good through quality education guided by Catholic values.

colleges.name: College of Arts and Sciences
colleges.description: The College of Arts and Sciences provides a broad liberal arts and sciences education, developing well-rounded graduates prepared for leadership in diverse fields.
colleges.vision: To be a premier college developing globally competent graduates who are critical thinkers and ethical leaders.
colleges.mission: To provide quality education in arts and sciences through rigorous academic programs, meaningful research, and transformative community engagement.

colleges.name: College of Business Administration
colleges.description: The College of Business Administration prepares future business leaders with a strong foundation in management, finance, marketing, and entrepreneurship.
colleges.vision: To be a center of excellence in business education producing globally competitive and ethical business professionals.
colleges.mission: To develop competent, innovative, and socially responsible business leaders through quality education, relevant research, and meaningful community partnerships.

colleges.name: College of Computing and Architecture
colleges.description: The College of Computing and Architecture fosters innovation through programs in computer science, information technology, and architecture, preparing graduates for the digital age.
colleges.vision: To be a leading college in computing and architecture, driving innovation and technological advancement in the region.
colleges.mission: To produce technically excellent, creative, and ethical computing and architecture professionals through rigorous academic programs and industry collaboration.

colleges.name: College of Education
colleges.description: The College of Education shapes the future of learning by developing passionate, skilled, and values-driven educators committed to transformative teaching.
colleges.vision: To be a center of excellence in teacher education producing globally competitive and Christ-centered educators.
colleges.mission: To develop highly qualified, reflective, and ethical educators who are committed to continuous professional growth and service to the community.

colleges.name: College of Engineering
colleges.description: The College of Engineering develops skilled engineers who apply scientific and technological knowledge to solve real-world problems with integrity and innovation.
colleges.vision: To be a premier engineering college producing globally competitive, innovative, and ethically responsible engineers.
colleges.mission: To provide quality engineering education that integrates technical excellence, research, and social responsibility.

colleges.name: College of Health Sciences
colleges.description: The College of Health Sciences produces competent and compassionate health professionals dedicated to promoting wellness and serving communities.
colleges.vision: To be a leading health sciences institution developing compassionate, competent, and Christ-centered health professionals.
colleges.mission: To produce globally competent health professionals through excellence in health education, research, and community service.

colleges.name: College of Science and Mathematics
colleges.description: The College of Science and Mathematics cultivates analytical minds and scientific literacy through rigorous programs in pure and applied sciences.
colleges.vision: To be a center of scientific excellence nurturing critical thinkers and researchers who advance knowledge and contribute to national development.
colleges.mission: To provide a strong foundation in science and mathematics through quality instruction, meaningful research, and active community engagement.

colleges.name: School of Law
colleges.description: The School of Law produces lawyers and legal professionals committed to justice, ethical practice, and the rule of law in service of the Filipino people.
colleges.vision: To be a premier law school producing competent, ethical, and socially responsible legal professionals.
colleges.mission: To develop lawyers and legal professionals with a deep commitment to justice, human dignity, and the common good through rigorous legal education.
